title: cart.cart
description: A Customer's Cart, published when it is abandoned: it held Variants and went unchanged for ecomm.cart.abandoned-after. Published at least once per abandonment, with the same eventId each time. Keyed by customerId.

eventId.description: Derived from the Customer and lastChangedAt, so the same abandonment published twice has the same eventId.

customerId.description: The Customer whose Cart it is: the message key.

version.description: lastChangedAt in epoch milliseconds, which goes up with every change to the Cart. Apply an event only if it is newer than what you hold.

items.description: The Cart's lines, in Variant ID order.

lastChangedAt.description: When the Cart last changed, before it was abandoned.
